what: How many Lunenburg children were placed out of district in the 2010 school year?
why: `placement-counts` holds this from the Special Services report in the FY2013-FY2025 annual town reports. The 2010 annual town report prints no Special Services report and no placement count: its Textract text was searched for special services, special education, SIMS and placement, and returned only a coordinator's name and a retirement notice (sources/data/report-tables/2010/). — closes: DESE's SIMS placement report for Lunenburg for 2009-10, or the district's own Special Services annual report for 2010.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2010 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2010 annual town report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF pages 71-73) with no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: its Textract text was searched for debt limit, long-term indebtedness and outstanding debt and returned nothing. — closes: the Town's FY2010 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.
